key_patterns: Hexagonal: application (dto/{request,response}, port/{in, out/{persistence,externalapi}}, service/impl, util) + domain (enums, exception, model) + infrastructure (adapter/{input/web/controller, out/persistence/{adapter,entity,mapper,repository}}, config). findu-core controllers use @RequiredArgsConstructor + constructor-injected UseCase ports + rich @Operation/@ApiResponses OpenAPI annotations (see OfertaController). Persistence adapters implement application/port/out ports and are the ONLY place that knows the datastore. DynamoDB access is raw AWS SDK v2 DynamoDbClient (getItem/updateItem today; add transactWriteItems/query/putItem). Render replaces {{clave}} via String.replace in TemplateServiceImpl.
